name.ja: HG 1/144 GQuuuuuuX(エンディミオン・ユニット覚醒時)

description.ja: エンディミオン・ユニット覚醒時のGQuuuuuuXが遂に登場！
description.en: GQuuuuuuX when Endymion unit awakens is finally here!

description.ja: 頭部ユニットの開閉ギミックを搭載し、エフェクトはPETシートで再現！
description.en: Equipped with an opening/closing gimmick for the head unit, and the effect is reproduced with PET sheet!

description.ja: ■頭部ユニットの開閉ギミックを搭載。
description.en: • Equipped with an opening/closing gimmick for the head unit.

description.ja: ■エフェクトはPETシートで再現。
description.en: • Effects are reproduced with PET sheets.

description.ja: ■特徴的な機体フォルムを忠実に再現。
description.en: • Faithfully reproduces the characteristic aircraft form.

description.ja: ■胴体、股関節など各部関節の可動によりダイナミックなアクションポーズが可能。
description.en: • Dynamic action poses are possible by movable joints such as the torso and hip joints.

description.ja: ■バリエーション豊かな各種武装が付属。
description.en: • Comes with a wide variety of weapons.
